title: Large I O relay panel
goal: A reader must be able to map sixteen numbered terminals through eight inputs to eight relay outputs and their status lamps.

rubric.must: A terminal strip visibly shows terminals numbered 1 through 16.
Eight separate input switches labelled INPUT 1 through INPUT 8 are visible.
Eight distinct 24 VDC relay coils labelled OUTPUT 1 through OUTPUT 8 are visible.
Eight green pilot lights labelled OUT 1 through OUT 8 are visible.
Eight normally open relay contacts labelled K1 CONTACT through K8 CONTACT are visible.
A shared 24 VDC 10 A supply feeds all channels through one clearly labelled 5 A main fuse.
The complete panel remains legible with no component symbols or reference labels overlapping.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Sixty components stay readable because the eight identical channels become eight equal rows, the terminal block is a single numbered column with inputs on one side and outputs on the other, and a terminal map closes the sheet. This is the target for layout at scale.
